searchText: Does anyone know how to get 32+ Goerli ETH to test through the Goerli / Prater merge? I had a good samaratin give me Ropsten ETH to allow testing running a validator there which was great. The faucets all are very laborious to get test ETH. Thanks for any help! Is there going to be an analogous central site as https://kiln.themerge.dev/ for Goerli/Prater, linking to the block explorer(s), launchpad-guide, etc all in one place to point people to? We have https://goerli.net/ and https://sepolia.dev/ Both community run 😄
